Bug_Title: Identical expressions should not be used on both sides of a binary operator
Bug_Explanation: The code contains several instances of identical expressions being used on both sides of a binary operator, which is a code defect and violates the rule 'Identical expressions should not be used on both sides of a binary operator'.
